name: bridge-get-status
description: Slim ChievFX bridge health snapshot: heartbeat, compile/import busy state, recent operations, event-wait liveness, and editorHealth problems when there are any (high reserved memory, low Play fps, EditorApplication.update subscribers and render textures left by scripts). Check before longer orchestration and after a long agent run. Pass verbose=true for full diagnostics, including the health block (reservedMb, bytesAssemblies, ...).

verbose.description: Return the full diagnostic shape (editor/busy/health/eventWaits/counts blocks plus per-op timestamps).

maxOperations.description: Maximum recent (terminal) operation rows to include. Defaults to 0; active ops are always returned when present.
